inventorySummary: Nginx is acting as the primary ingress gateway. SSH is publicly reachable and should be constrained.
architectureNotes: Customer traffic lands on port 443, is terminated by Nginx, and forwarded to internal app and auth services.

ports.notes: Should be limited to management access.

risks.title: SSH exposed to the public internet
risks.recommendation: Move SSH behind a bastion or private management plane.
